meta.title: Contact us – property management in Mauritius
meta.description: Talk to Bellavere about managing your villa or apartment anywhere in Mauritius — rentals, maintenance, client care and concierge under one roof.

header.title: Let’s talk about your property
header.intro: Tell us about your villa or apartment. A real person will reply {responseTime}, and we’ll give you an honest view of what it could earn.

details.writeNote: Every query answered {responseTime} — by a person, never a bot.

formCard.intro: A few details are all we need to get started.

success.title: Message received
success.body: Thank you — a real person from our team will read your message and reply the same day.

faq.title: Questions owners ask
faq.sub: The short answers first — for everything else, we’re one message away.

reply.question: How quickly will you get back to me?
reply.answer: The same day — every query, every time. {names} can be reached every day, 24/7, on the numbers on this page.

payouts.question: When do I get paid?
payouts.answer: Every month you receive a full statement — gross income, our fee and any expenses, line by line. Payout timing is set out in your management agreement.

ownUse.question: Can I still use my property?
ownUse.answer: Of course — it’s your home. Talk to your client-relations contact about the dates you need; how owner stays work is set out in your management agreement.

onboarding.question: How fast is onboarding?
onboarding.answer: One to two weeks from our first meeting. In that time we inspect the property, agree your fee and set up your listing.
